integrity: The finite program is a reproducibility check, not a replacement for the analytic all-dimensional proof. Full text of two very recent systematicity sources was inaccessible; an independently validated originality judgment is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Systematic binary linear encoding only; Hamming data distance at least 3 and parity-function separation at least 4. The all-dimensional upper bound invokes the published Davydov--Tombak sum-free theorem; no claim for nonlinear codes.
title: Sharp parity-separation profile and all optimal systematic linear encoders
